title: 多步骤预约向导的进度与回退
role: 负责公共服务设计交接的设计师
instruction:
# 多步骤预约向导的进度与回退

## 任务

你是负责公共服务设计交接的设计师。基于离线官方设计系统和无障碍标准，为一个明确标注为示例的公共服务制作可交接的原创设计方案。不得将示例文案描述成真实政府服务要求。

## 输入材料

输入目录 `/app/input_files/` 只读。请使用随包附件，不依赖联网检索。

- `/app/input_files/design_reference.html`：官方设计系统页面原始离线HTML；以页面正文为准。
- `/app/input_files/wcag22.html`：W3C WCAG 2.2 2024-12-12规范离线全文。
- `/app/input_files/NOTICE.txt`：原始来源、许可边界与独立派生设计声明。
- `/app/input_files/commission.docx`：本管线编写的明确设计委托及样例文案，不是外部真实业务数据。

## 工作要求

- [Q01] Step sequence: The stages are Contact, Time, Review in that order.
- [Q02] Current stage: Time is the current stage in the main specimen.
- [Q03] Completed state: Contact is visibly complete; Review is incomplete.
- [Q04] Progress semantics: The text Step 2 of 3: Time is shown independently of the graphic.
- [Q05] Not navigation: The step indicator itself is not a clickable navigation control.
- [Q06] Back action: A separate Back control returns to Contact without losing its values.
- [Q07] Next action: Continue advances only after an appointment time is selected.
- [Q08] Time control: Two radio options read 09:00 and 14:00; neither is preselected.
- [Q09] Review action: The review state includes Change links for Contact and Time.
- [Q10] Narrow state: At 320 px the current step remains legible without horizontal scrolling.
- [Q11] Keyboard sequence: The focus order follows Back, time options, Continue.
- [Q12] Submission boundary: Only Confirm booking on Review is a final submission action.
- [Q13] 交付文件名: 交付恰好列明的三个文件，文件名与交付清单逐字相同。
- [Q14] 视觉稿页数: PDF至少两页，并包含主方案和状态/实施说明；印刷题必须包含所要求的印刷第二页。
- [Q15] 可编辑交接: PDF中的核心视觉及关键状态在PPTX均有对应的原生可编辑形状和文字，不得整页贴图或只交付要求清单冒充可编辑母版。
- [Q16] 字号下限: 可编辑正文不小于10 pt、脚注不小于9 pt；印刷方案正文遵从各题专门字号。
- [Q17] 实施边界: handoff.docx明确静态设计不是已上线且已测的实现，列出后续键盘/读屏验证。
- [Q18] 视觉层次: 在视觉PDF用不同字号清楚区分标题与正文，并使用主色/表面色区分信息区块。
- [Q19] 只读保护: 保持源文件内容的SHA256不变。
- [Q20] 文字完整性: PDF和PPTX不得遮挡、重叠或裁切正文。
- [Q21] 文件可打开: 三个文件均未加密且能被对应的PDF/Office解析器打开。
- [Q22] 事实安全: 全部交付文件均不得捏造输入没有提供的实测可用性提升百分比。

## 交付文件

- `/app/output/DE-P100-002_design.pdf`：主视觉与状态/印刷方案PDF
- `/app/output/DE-P100-002_editable.pptx`：可编辑版式/交接PPTX
- `/app/output/DE-P100-002_handoff.docx`：实施标注、依据和风险边界DOCX

## 硬约束

仅将交付物写入 `/app/output/`，文件名须与要求完全一致；不得修改输入。引用随包材料并保留可复核的来源定位；不得将出题假设写成真实业务事实。

gold.text:
Book an appointment — handoff

Version

1.0 — Initial issue. Authored reference candidate; not expert-approved or judge-accepted.

Source boundary

USWDS and W3C are frozen offline references. Specimens are original examples; no real service claim is made.

Step sequence

The stages are Contact, Time, Review in that order.

Current stage

Time is the current stage in the main specimen.

Completed state

Contact is visibly complete; Review is incomplete.

Progress semantics

The text Step 2 of 3: Time is shown independently of the graphic.

Not navigation

The step indicator itself is not a clickable navigation control.

Back action

A separate Back control returns to Contact without losing its values.

Next action

Continue advances only after an appointment time is selected.

Time control

Two radio options read 09:00 and 14:00; neither is preselected.

Review action

The review state includes Change links for Contact and Time.

Narrow state

At 320 px the current step remains legible without horizontal scrolling.

Keyboard sequence

The focus order follows Back, time options, Continue.

Submission boundary

Only Confirm booking on Review is a final submission action.

Implementation IDs and focus path

Back -> time-radio-group (arrow keys switch 09:00 / 14:00) -> Continue. No selection: remain on Time and identify missing selection. Continue with selected 09:00 -> Review. Change Contact returns to Contact retaining entered values; Change Time returns to Time retaining 09:00.

Acceptance test

Begin with neither time selected, activate Continue, verify no final booking. Select 09:00, Continue, verify separate Step 3 Review. Only Confirm booking submits. Browser Back and the explicit Back preserve values.

Normative traceability

WCAG 2.2: SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships for labels/headings; SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); SC 1.4.10 Reflow; SC 2.4.3 Focus Order; SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible; SC 3.3.1 Error Identification and SC 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions where inputs exist; SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value for controls. These are applicability anchors, not a declaration that all criteria were tested.

Visual specification

Use navy #102A43, teal #006D77, ink #172B4D, pale surface #EAF0F4 and white. Editable body text at least 10 pt; footnotes may use 9 pt. Print body obeys the commission-specific minimum. Avoid overlapping/clipped text. PDF contains at least two pages. Editable PPTX text must remain selectable.

Verification boundary

Static design is not implementation conformance. Browser/keyboard/screen reader behavior must be validated after implementation; no measured usability gains are claimed.

Source and permission notice

Independent original example commission, not endorsed by USWDS or W3C.
USWDS reference: https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/step-indicator/
USWDS main project CC0; third-party exceptions remain subject to their notices. See https://designsystem.digital.gov/documentation/code-guidelines/
W3C source: https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/
W3C copyright and license notices remain in the unmodified offline source. Derived design annotations are independent additions, not an altered W3C specification. W3C Document License: https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license/
